policy: Frozen English wav2vec2-base-960h, greedy transcript with the existing wake regex. Exactly the lexical search PCM or a 1.44 s PCM crop ending with the five-class verifier. Merge at crop end with C161 and existing cooldown. Also union the short-window CTC result with the Q8 name-contrast and five-class joint confirmations before cooldown. Compare full address sentences in the three context streams for diagnosis only. GPU software reference; notification times exclude inference.
